junk_imagery.evidence: Every frame is in-house illustration on topic: a hunched man with a red pain burst (hook@0.3), a clinic queue (seg1:start), a spine on a stand (seg2:start), a warehouse worker under boxes (seg3:start), a man under a sack (seg4:start).

decorative_mascot.evidence: Data mostly does the work in each scene: he holds the queue rope at the post as the line grows (seg1:mid/end), turns the vise crank by the spine (seg2:mid/end), stands on the box stack piling it onto the worker (seg3:mid/end) and hauls the rope that lifts the sack off the man's back (seg4:mid, payoff@-1.8). The hook is the exception: there he only sways on a cardboard box.

bare_number_card.evidence: Each number sits on a picture that acts it out: 843M over a longer queue (seg1:end), +53% over a taller box stack with a 2021 ghost box (seg3:end), 1.5x over a sack bigger than its 1990 outline (seg4:end).

dead_air.evidence: Measured longest_static_s is 0 and the longest duplicate run is about 1.3s. Things move in every segment: the queue lengthens, the spine straightens, boxes stack, the sack lifts.

empty_void.evidence: Full-bleed scenes use the whole frame (seg1, seg2, seg3, seg4). There are no dark empty areas (dark_fraction 0.0).

unreadable.evidence: Headlines and captions read at phone size. The small labels '2020' over the queue (seg1:mid), '61% other causes' (seg2:end) and '1990'/'2021' by the boxes (seg3:end) are small but legible. The faint captions in seg1:start and seg3:start are mid-fade, not stuck that way.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: In seg2:start through seg2:end a bent, glowing spine straightens a little on a stand beside a vise. '39%' shows top-left and '61% other causes' sits on a thin grey arc with 'fixable' on a short cyan arc, small labels floating beside the spine. A viewer cannot see four in ten of the cases being fixed.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The split is carried by two thin arcs and text labels beside the spine. Nothing in the spine itself splits into a fixable 39% and an unfixable 61%. Data only turns a crank and nothing visibly follows from it.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the spine show the split. Turn about 4 of every 10 vertebrae (or 39% of the glowing pain) into the fixable part, and have Data clear that part with each turn of the crank while the other 61% stays lit, so the claim reads without the labels.

depictions.note: A queue of bent-over back-pain patients outside a clinic grows longer from 619M to 843M with a 2020 marker. The growth is visible, but how much longer the line gets is not easy to read.
A spine on a stand with a vise. The 39/61 split is carried by thin arcs and labels, not by the spine.
A worker bent under a growing box stack with a ghost box for 2021. The load is made of the subject, though the size of the +53% is only partly readable.
A sack bigger than its 1990 dashed outline weighs on the man's back. Data hoists it off and the man straightens up, a good payoff.

grades.one_line: Strong illustrated scenes with Data doing the work. The spine beat is the weak link: its 39% split lives in labels, not in the picture.
problems: Hook: Data sways on a cardboard box without doing anything about the man's pain (hook@0.3 to hook@2.2).
seg2: the 39% fixable vs 61% split shows only as thin arcs and floating labels next to the spine, and Data's crank has no visible effect.
seg1: the 2020 marker and how much the queue grew are hard to see. The line gets longer but the third more is not obvious.
seg3: the '1990' label sits on the worker's hard hat and '2021' floats by a faint ghost box, both small.
fixes: seg2: draw the 39% inside the spine (about 4 of 10 vertebrae marked fixable) and have each turn of Data's crank clear the pain from those vertebrae while the rest stays red.
Hook: give Data one quick action from the first frame, such as reaching to steady the man's back or pulling a pain marker off him.
seg1: mark the 2020 end of the queue clearly so the extra third added by 2050 stands out as new people joining the line.
seg3: put the 1990 and 2021 heights as clear marks on the stack itself, not on the hard hat.
